steps.content: As night deepens, the bustling MBCC detention area gradually quiets down. Even the night owls have retreated to their rooms, now fast asleep.
Angell is lying on the bed in the temporary room you've arranged for her, unable to fall asleep.
Days are passing by, living this lie, Not knowing what we're looking for. Gray, these walls are gray and there's no sky. There is no hope, there is no soar. I know somewhere there must be more.
The familiar lyrics and melody echo in the headphones. Normally, this song would lull her to sleep quickly, but not tonight.
Her brain refuses to rest, her thoughts uncontrollably drifting back to the time she spent with you, the memories replaying over and over in her head.
...Haven't started cooking yet. Just about to make the red bean soup you asked for.
Do you know any doctors? Or a safe underground clinic? You should still get it checked. The wound is deep, it might get infected.
I'll miss the time I spent with you.
Sometimes you just stumble upon a chance that brings you into the sunlight, where you can meet people who need help or have good intentions.
If my offer doesn't sound bad... come with me.
The next second, her thoughts drift from the safe house to the cinema this afternoon.
But now that you've told me how you feel about this, I won't insist.
I respect your decision. I won't impose my own beliefs on you anymore.
Since you can't accept this kind of life, I won't go against your wishes and force you to stay.
Angell knows how frequently she fails to convey her thoughts.

She's not talkative, and doesn't believe that "talking" has any function beyond exchanging information. She speaks as little as possible at work already, and there's little need for her to express her emotions and feelings.

However, over these past few days with ${PlayerName}, she seems to have spoken much more than she has in her entire life. Normally, when she's by herself, she can go two weeks without uttering a single word.
The opinions or feelings of others mean nothing to her, so she doesn't care if her words cause any misunderstanding.
But after meeting ${PlayerName}, she worries about whether she can fully and accurately express herself for the first time.
There have been others who wanted to "save" her, but most of them only told her that the bright world could offer her protection and allow her to live an ordinary life in peace.
They never considered whether someone like her could truly get used to, and live a good life under the sun. However, Chief has thought of everything.
He's different.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Maybe I didn't make myself clear.
Angell sighs and turns. She doesn't want to upset you, or cause even the slightest misunderstanding because she can't express herself.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I should explain tomorrow...
Angell doesn't remember when she fell asleep.
The safe house is shrouded in a misty, soft light. She sits on the couch as you come in, with shopping bags in hand.
As usual, you complain about her living habits and the mess she's made in the house, and surprisingly, you suggest cleaning up together for the first time.
Just as she's about to take the broom, Angell is jolted awake by a sudden alarm.
She stares at the unfamiliar ceiling for some time before remembering that she is leaving MBCC this morning, just as she said before.
After washing up, Angell leaves the room and walks towards the MBCC gates. The corridor is empty due to the early hours.
Just as you promised, no one is there to stop Angell as she leaves. It's quiet, and she senses no danger, but she hears her own heartbeat, pounding and quickening.
Her anxiety peaks when she sees you waiting at the gate from afar, and she stops in her tracks.
You hear her footsteps and walk towards her.
Angell feels the weight in her hands and looks down, noticing a thermal bag. It appears somewhat bulging and blocky, and feels warm to the touch.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: This is...?
I bet you're leaving on an empty stomach since it's still early. I packed these from the kitchen. All your favorites. You can eat them on the way.
Oh, and there's this...
You fish out a key from your pocket and hand it over to her.
This is the key you gave me. You can stay there when you go back.
I've been cleaning that safe house, but I didn't touch anything in your room. The goldfish you left with me are all alive and well. If you're staying in the safe house, I can send them back.
I've already topped up your electricity account. It should be more than enough to last a couple of years.
If there's an emergency, you can still use your backup generator. I've charged it and put it in the bottom drawer of the living room cabinet.
Also, that broken microwave in your kitchen, I've asked someone to fix it. It's working fine now.
I've stocked the fridge with fresh ingredients. You can make something simple. If you don't feel like cooking, there are also ready meals and instant food you can heat up in the microwave.
I've written down the reheating instructions for each item on memo papers and stuck them on the boxes.

Oh, I also wrote down a red bean soup recipe and put it on the fridge. Since you like it so much, you can try making it yourself. The instructions are detailed, so you shouldn't have any major issues if you follow them step by step.
Hmm... I guess that's everything? I was going to tell you all this when you returned to the safe house, but I never thought you'd go out of your way to avoid me.
You try to lighten the mood since Angell hasn't said anything, but she takes it very seriously and begins to explain:

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I wasn't avoiding you. I just couldn't go back because of those loose ends. I didn't want to risk bringing them home.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: But now that it's almost over... I'll head back.
That's good to hear.
Relax. I was just messing with you.
You give a comforting smile, but she grips the key tighter, and pauses for a moment before she continues:

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I'm okay. There's just something I want you to know.
Sure, I'm listening. Take your time.
Reassured and encouraged by the look in your eyes, she continues.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: It's true that what I said in the cinema yesterday was my lifelong beliefs, but I choose not to stay not because I dislike you, or hold something against you.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: On the contrary, I cherish the time we spent together in the safe house, and I've never held a grudge against you for hiding things from me.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You showed me a different world and things I've never seen before. It was a great memory.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Before I met you, I hardly ever took orders. I used to spend time investigating the targets to make sure I could bring myself to do it. A simple kidnapping job is quite rare on the dark web.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: It was nice to have you picking orders for me. I actually like those odd jobs that can help people, but I could never find them on my own before because browsing and filtering through all that malicious information always tired me out.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I did have my own selfish reasons back then. I didn't want you to leave. Even though I knew we didn't belong to the same world and I couldn't stop you from returning to the sunlight, I still wanted to stay with you a bit longer.
It was a lovely memory. Whenever I think back on those moments, they always warm my heart.
You unconsciously smile and nod.
That was a rare, peaceful time for me too. Even though I knew it couldn't last, I didn't want it to end either.
So, I was actually a bit sad when you decided not to come with me, but I do feel better now that I know you cherish that time as much as I do.
Angell sighs softly.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: The dark side of the world will always exist, and the darkness in my heart can't be erased. I couldn't come with you because I was afraid that a monster like me, or the dangers around me, might hurt you.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: ...I was also afraid that after being exposed to too much warmth and kindness, I wouldn't be able to continue living in the shadows.
She pauses for a moment, then looks at you seriously again.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: But this time, I want to thank you properly in person. I'm grateful for everything you've done, and I'm happy that we met.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: In the past, my way of reminiscing about the past involved only red bean soup and goldfish, but you and that interesting job have given me a new idea—I could do what I'm good at and cut through the darkness to guard those who live under the sun.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I'm happy with myself as I am now, just as you are proud of your way of life. I hope to receive the blessing of a dear friend.
Angell remains as calm and composed as ever, but this time, you feel the sincerity and hope in her every word.
It's like she's finally laying her heart bare before you. Suddenly, you also feel an indescribable feeling in your heart.
So, you take a deep breath and look into her eyes, and say to her earnestly:
I understand how you feel.
Your body somehow turns into a small wooden cutout, and is placed onstage.
I'm content now that I know you don't actually dislike those people and that kind of life.
I didn't mean to show you the "life under the sunlight" to change your lifestyle.

I just wanted you to see a different kind of life and possibilities, so you'd know that here, there are people who will protect and support you, just like how you've been protecting me from the shadows.
If you ever feel tired in the shadows, you can come out to bask in the sun. I will always be here waiting and welcoming you.
As you speak, you're also watching Angell's reactions.
She loosens her grip on the strap of her bag, and her face relaxes as if a massive burden has been lifted from her heart, bringing her a sense of relief.
After getting to know her, you realize that this cold assassin isn't emotionless, she's simply much more reserved compared to most people.
Despite her habit of hiding and suppressing her feelings, you can begin to recognize them in the subtle details, such as her slowly relaxing eyebrows and the faint curve forming on her lips.
But you're wrong about one thing.
You intentionally put on a stern face, changing the subject.
Sure enough, Angell raises her eyebrow slightly, confused but patiently waits for you to continue.
I'm stronger than you think. Those things in the shadows have been trying to get rid of me forever, but they've never succeeded. So trust me, you can't hurt me.

And you're not some monster either. You're one of the strongest people I've ever met. As you said, shadows will always exist, but if everyone living in there was like you, it would actually be a good thing for all of us.

I also believe that, someone as strong as you can always find the strength to live in the darkness no matter what, and the warmth and kindness you feel will only fuel your determination to go further.
Angell seems touched, and you smile softly. The sky has lost its morning glow at some point, revealing a clear blue behind the golden clouds.
I shouldn't keep you here any longer. I've truly said everything I wanted to say this time.
You can go back to your life. I won't bother you anymore in the future. Just take good care of yourself, alright?
Well then... Goodbye, Angell.
You wave goodbye at her, but she holds you by your wrist as you turn back.

Angell parts her lips urgently, but averts her gaze the moment your eyes meet. It's like she has something to say but fails to find the words. Instead of rushing her, you simply enjoy this rare sight of her struggling with herself.
After a long time, she finally lifts her head like she's ready to risk everything, and says earnestly.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I don't want you to stop bothering me.
You raise your eyebrows. You're trying to "force" her to say this, but hearing it from her still catches you by surprise.
You clear your throat, adjust your expression, and nod solemnly.
Okay.
It seems your prompt and brief answer leaves her puzzled and uncertain. Angell hesitates for a moment before asking another question to make sure.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You... do understand what I mean, right?
Yes, I get it.
To reassure her, you continue:

On second thought, you're really bad at doing chores. I can't but worry even if you follow the recipe step by step. Making a mess is one thing, but what if you somehow blew up the kitchen or caused a safety hazard?
How about I drop by the safe house sometime and teach you in person? That should be much safer.
Angell doesn't feel upset because of your slight teasing. On the contrary, she simply nods.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You're right.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: You're always better at doing chores.
On a similar morning, you experience a similar farewell.
You watch as Angell walks into the distance once again, but this time with a completely different feeling.
You can barely contain your smile thinking about how she awkwardly said that she didn't want you to stop bothering her.
Perhaps this is why a proper goodbye is so important—it makes reunions something worth looking forward to.
